title: CulFiT: A Fine-grained Cultural-aware LLM Training Paradigm via Multilingual Critique Data Synthesis
reasoning: The paper introduces and uses the GlobalCultureQA benchmark, which includes 'religion' as one of its core topics. Furthermore, it evaluates cultural alignment using Hofstede's dimensions, which quantify cultural values and ethics, and includes qualitative analysis of religious-based social regulations (e.g., hijab laws).
